pr_title: drivers: misc: devmux: Include sys/types.h for better libc compatibility
pr_body:
ssize_t seems to be defined in sys/types.h which was incidentally being included into devmux.h when building with picolibc (see #70632 for details). However, this file was not included in the same way when using minimal libc, resulting in build failures that ssize_t was an unknown type.

As ssize_t is directly used in devmux.h, include sys/types.h to avoid this issue and enable building with minimal libc.

Fixes: #70632
pr_comments:
**Testing**
I tested this locally using Zephyr SDK with the following commands:
```
$ west twister -W -p qemu_riscv64 -s tests/drivers/console_switching/drivers.devmux.console_switching -x=CONFIG_MINIMAL_LIBC=y
$ west twister -W -p qemu_riscv64 -s tests/drivers/console_switching/drivers.devmux.console_switching.user -x=CONFIG_MINIMAL_LIBC=y
```
With this patch, both tests pass.

I also tested this locally with a build of clang/lld at f7669ba3d9443bc95dd63fa25beea13e6265fdc5 (so ~2 months old) using the following command (I omitted `tests/drivers/console_switching/drivers.devmux.console_switching.user` as there is an unrelated lld failure):
```
$ west twister -W -p qemu_riscv64 -s tests/drivers/console_switching/drivers.devmux.console_switching -x=CONFIG_COMPILER_RT_RTLIB=y -x=CONFIG_LLVM_USE_LLD=y
```
With this patch, the test passes.

(P.S. I'm not at all familiar with this code so apologies if there are other limitations to building devmux with minimal libc that should be observed here, etc.! This _seemed_ like a case of just a missing #include, but again apologies in advance if this isn't appropriate.)

Thanks @cfriedt for checking this! It looks like the bot only added you as a reviewer--could you please help me with finding another person to look this over? I'll CC people who participated in the original devmux review below, but I'd greatly appreciate any additional suggestions as well! Thanks!

@fabiobaltieri, @gmarull, @ycsin, @faxe1008, or @jgl-meta would you be able to look this over as well, if appropriate? Thanks!

issue_context.title: console_switching tests fail if built with minimal libc
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
The below tests are both failing when building with Zephyr's minimal libc:
- `tests/drivers/console_switching/drivers.devmux.console_switching`
- `tests/drivers/console_switching/drivers.devmux.console_switching.user`

The tests fail with errors that `ssize_t` is an unknown type name (see "Logs and console output").

I've only tested this on the `qemu_riscv64` board, but the behavior is consistent when building with Zephyr's toolchain (SDK v0.16.5-1) and manually selecting minimal libc as well as when building with clang (which seems to default to minimal libc). Zephyr's toolchain is able to handle this if using picolibc and the tests pass as expected. I _think_ this is a case of a missing include (see "Logs and console output") so I think this is a (minor) issue in the source rather than a toolchain or libc bug.

**To Reproduce**
Run the tests configured to use minimal libc. I am using the following command with `ZEPHYR_TOOLCHAIN_VARIANT=zephyr` set (though the failure is also visible when using clang/llvm):

```
$ west twister -W -p qemu_riscv64 -s tests/drivers/console_switching/drivers.devmux.console_switching.user -x=CONFIG_MINIMAL_LIBC=y
```

**Expected behavior**
The tests build successfully and pass.

**Impact**
This seems to prevent devmux(?) from being built in combination with minimal libc. I only encountered this while working through test failures when building the tests for `qemu_riscv32` and `qemu_riscv64` with clang--it isn't blocking, but it would be nice to fix or understand the failure to ensure it isn't a toolchain issue!

**Logs and console output**
The errors are as below (taken from building `tests/drivers/console_switching/drivers.devmux.console_switching.user`):
```
In file included from /workdir/zephyr/drivers/misc/devmux/devmux.c:10:
../../../../../../include/zephyr/drivers/misc/devmux/devmux.h:66:11: error: unknown type name 'ssize_t'
   66 | __syscall ssize_t devmux_select_get(const struct device *dev);
      |           ^~~~~~~
In file included from ../../../../../../include/zephyr/drivers/misc/devmux/devmux.h:89:
zephyr/include/generated/syscalls/devmux.h:23:8: error: unknown type name 'ssize_t'
   23 | extern ssize_t z_impl_devmux_select_get(const struct device * dev);
      |        ^~~~~~~
zephyr/include/generated/syscalls/devmux.h:26:15: error: unknown type name 'ssize_t'
   26 | static inline ssize_t devmux_select_get(const struct device * dev)
      |               ^~~~~~~
zephyr/include/generated/syscalls/devmux.h: In function 'devmux_select_get':
zephyr/include/generated/syscalls/devmux.h:31:25: error: 'ssize_t' undeclared (first use in this function); did yo
u mean 'size_t'?
   31 |                 return (ssize_t) arch_syscall_invoke1(parm0.x, K_SYSCALL_DEVMUX_SELECT_GET);
      |                         ^~~~~~~
      |                         size_t
```

If I build using Zephyr's toolchain + picolibc with `-save-temps` and `-H` added, it looks like `ssize_t` is being picked up through `picolibc/include/sys/types.h` (based on the contents of `devmux.c.i`). Based on the `-H` output, it looks like `picolibc/include/sys/types.h` is only incidentally being included. Abbreviated `-H` output for `devmux.c` is below:
```
. ../include/zephyr/drivers/misc/devmux/devmux.h
.. ../include/zephyr/kernel.h
... ../include/zephyr/kernel_includes.h
.... ../include/zephyr/sys/printk.h
..... /opt/toolchains/zephyr-sdk-0.16.5-1/riscv64-zephyr-elf/picolibc/include/stdio.h
...... /opt/toolchains/zephyr-sdk-0.16.5-1/riscv64-zephyr-elf/picolibc/include/sys/types.h
```

This sort of "incidental include" doesn't seem to happen for minimal libc, so we don't pull in `sys/types.h` and never see a definition for `ssize_t`. So, I'm guessing the fix is just to make sure `sys/types.h` is included in `devmux.h`.

**Environment**
 - OS: Ubuntu 20.04
 - Toolchain: Zephyr SDK v0.16.5-1
 - Zephyr commit SHA: 37a1d28a36aecbfd2f5f054230462e8df45777f0

review_comments: This could technically be moved up a line following the coding guidelines suggested by @gmarrul

Rather than including a posix header here, in a "below the line" header, let's stick to ISO C.

That should involve a few changes in the following files:
* `include/zephyr/drivers/misc/devmux/devmux.h` (this file)
* `drivers/misc/devmux/devmux.c`
* `tests/drivers/console_switching/src/main.c`

If possible, please split your changes into 2 commits (in this PR) - the first commit for `lib/` and `include/`, and the second commit for `tests/`.
